shared_vectors.ownership_contract: Never read or change the partner bank; never disable/unpend shared NVIC vector; no shared BTIM reset or gate-off; dispatch all enabled partner sources through their owners.

runtime_source_control: Continuous owned bit0 IRQ enable. ISR checks active+enable+flag, acknowledges only overflow and latches/wakes without masking. Wait cancellation has no writes. Constructor/Drop arm/mask with bank stopped; whole-bank initialization/final cleanup disables owned DMA requests as before.
limits: Sticky overflow flags coalesce. No simultaneous-clear/new-event priority, lossless count, boundary timestamp or fixed interrupt latency is assumed.
Native URS=1 and UDIS=0 select overflow IRQ/DMA causes. CR2.MMS=0 forwards EGR.UG to TRGO and is not a trigger-output disconnect.
Never read or modify a shared partner bank, disable/unpend a vector, change its priority, assert BTIM shared reset or gate the BTIM group off.
No GTIM/ATIM async IRQ admission, DMA API, new trigger mode, clock-loss recovery, wall-clock deadline or sleep/wake guarantee.
